source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; VanderKam 1984 Enoch and the Growth of an Apocalyptic Tradition.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 36 — SOUTHERN GATES OF HEAVEN + FINAL DOXOLOGY — **GE'EZ IS THE ONLY COMPLETE WITNESS; Akhmim Greek not preserved; Aramaic 4Q205 sparse fragments.** Closes the Book of the Watchers (chs 1-36).

verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ መንገለ፡ አዜብ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ምድር፡ ወህየ፡ ርእኩ፡ ሠለስተ፡ አናቅጸ፡ ሰማይ፡ ክሥቱተ፡ እምነ፡ መንገለ፡ አዜብ፡ ወእምኔሆሙ፡ ይወፅእ፡ ጠል፡ ወዝናም፡ ወነፋስ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmhəya ḥorku mangala ʾazēb ʾaṣnāfa mədr wa-həya rəʾku śalasta ʾanāqəḍa samāy kəśtuta ʾəmənna mangala ʾazēb wa-ʾəmənnehomu yəwaḍḍəʾ ṭall wa-zənām wa-nafās
verses.notes: Enoch journeys to the southern ends of the earth — three southern gates of heaven open, sending out dew, rain, and wind. Mirror of the northern gates of ch 34.

verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕተ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወህየ፡ ርእኩ፡ አጽናፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ ክሥቱተ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ወመጻንሕተ፡ ንኡሳነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ እለ፡ እምኔሆን፡ ይወፅአ፡ ከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወየሐውር፡ መንገለ፡ ዐረብ፡ በፍኖት፡ ዘአርአዮሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmhəya ḥorku mangala ṣəbāḥta ʾaṣnāfa samāy kwəlomu wa-həya rəʾku ʾaṣnāfa samāy kəśtuta mangala ṣəbāḥ wa-maṣānəḥta nəʾusāna lāʿlehu ʾəlla ʾəmənnehon yəwaḍḍəʾa kawākəbta samāy wa-yaḥawwər mangala ʿarab ba-fənot za-ʾarʾayomu
verses.notes: Enoch revisits the eastern ends of the heavens — small openings above through which the stars of heaven come out and travel to the west along the appointed path. The cosmic-circuit of stars closes the systematic celestial-geography.

verses.text_geez: ወአመ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ባረክኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘላእምር፡ ባረክዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ ስብሐት፡ ዘገብረ፡ ተአምራተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ከመ፡ ያርእዮሙ፡ ለሰራዊተ፡ መላእክቲሁ፡ ወመናፍስት፡ ወለሰብእ፡ ዕበየ፡ ምግባሩ፡ ከመ፡ ይባርክዎ፡ ግብሮ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ወይሬእዩ፡ ግብረ፡ ኀይሉ፡ ወይባርክዎ፡ ለዕበይ፡ ግብር፡ እደዊሁ፡ ወይባርክዎ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾama yərēʾəyu bārakku kwəlo za-lāʾəmər bārakəwwo la-ʾəgziʾa səbḥat za-gabra taʾāmərāta ʿabayta kama yārʾəyomu la-sarāwita malāʾəktihu wa-manāfəst wa-la-sabəʾ ʿəbaya məgbāru kama yəbārəkəwwo gəbro kwəlu gəbr wa-yərēʾəyu gəbra ḫaylu wa-yəbārəkəwwo la-ʿəbay gəbr ʾədawihu wa-yəbārəkəwwo la-ʿālama ʿālam
verses.witness_secondary: 4Q205 1 xii sparse closing-fragment (Milik 1976 pp. 220-223) — possibly preserves doxological closing language
verses.notes: **THE CLOSING DOXOLOGY OF THE BOOK OF THE WATCHERS.** When Enoch saw the cosmic order, he blessed the Lord of Glory who made great marvels to show to his host of angels, to spirits, and to humanity the greatness of his work — that they might bless all his work and see his deeds of power and bless the great work of his hands and bless him for ever and ever. **Final benediction**: cf. Ps 145; Dan 2:20-23; Rev 5:13. **Marks the conclusion of the Book of the Watchers (chs 1-36).** The next major unit in 1 Enoch is the Book of Parables / Similitudes (chs 37-71), which is **not preserved in Aramaic at Qumran** (one of the most discussed text-critical puzzles in Enochic studies — Milik 1976 famously hypothesized Christian-era origin; mainstream scholarship now favors late Second Temple Jewish origin per Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012).
